steps.stdout:
The integrations a project can have: Mattermost posts task events to an
incoming webhook, webhook POSTs them to any HTTP endpoint, slack,
discord and telegram post them to chat, gitlab links the project to a
GitLab project, and github links it to a GitHub repository.

Mattermost, webhook, slack, discord and telegram have get, set and rm;
`set` creates the integration when the project has none and changes it
when it does. Gitlab's verbs are its own: get, connect, update, rm,
verify, projects and import. GitHub's verbs are app-info, repos, verify,
get, connect, update, rm and import.

Usage:
  kaneo integration [command]

Aliases:
  integration, integrations

Available Commands:
  discord     Show, set or remove the project's discord integration
  github      Work with the project's GitHub integration
  gitlab      Work with the project's GitLab integration
  mattermost  Mattermost integration for a project
  slack       Show, set or remove the project's slack integration
  telegram    Show, set or remove the project's telegram integration
  webhook     Outgoing webhook integration for a project

Flags:
  -h, --help   help for integration

Global Flags:
      --api-key string     API key; prefer KANEO_API_KEY, since a flag is visible in the process list
      --api-url string     Kaneo base URL (env KANEO_API_URL)
      --human              force human-readable output, even through a pipe
      --jq string          filter JSON output with a jq expression (implies --json)
      --json               force JSON output
  -p, --project string     project id, slug or name (env KANEO_PROJECT)
      --timeout duration   per-request timeout (default 10s)
  -w, --workspace string   workspace id, slug or name (env KANEO_WORKSPACE)

Use "kaneo integration [command] --help" for more information about a command.

Work with the project's GitHub integration

Usage:
  kaneo integration github [command]

Aliases:
  github, gh

Available Commands:
  app-info    Show the GitHub App this instance is configured with
  connect     Link the project to a GitHub repository
  get         Show the project's GitHub integration
  import      Import the repository's issues as tasks, resuming until done
  repos       List the repositories the GitHub App can reach, one page at a time
  rm          Disconnect the project from its GitHub repository
  update      Change the GitHub integration's settings
  verify      Check the App's installation and permissions on a repository

Flags:
  -h, --help   help for github

Global Flags:
      --api-key string     API key; prefer KANEO_API_KEY, since a flag is visible in the process list
      --api-url string     Kaneo base URL (env KANEO_API_URL)
      --human              force human-readable output, even through a pipe
      --jq string          filter JSON output with a jq expression (implies --json)
      --json               force JSON output
  -p, --project string     project id, slug or name (env KANEO_PROJECT)
      --timeout duration   per-request timeout (default 10s)
  -w, --workspace string   workspace id, slug or name (env KANEO_WORKSPACE)

Use "kaneo integration github [command] --help" for more information about a command.
